snippet.title: Dead Rising 2: Off the Record PLUS - A Fan-Made Expansion (OFFICIAL TRAILER)
snippet.description:
OFF THE RECORD PLUS - A FAN-MADE EXPANSION
https://www.nexusmods.com/deadrising2offtherecord/mods/30?tab=description

I hope you all enjoy this personal project I've been working on for the last month or so! I can't wait for more people to enjoy it. DR2 OTR will always be a special game in my heart, and this is my gift to the game and the community.
